==Speculative information of September 17==


Dear community,

On September 17, vast amounts of speculative information were added to Eldrene's page as facts. It is indicated that these facts stem from the Wheel of Time Companion, and I implore anyone in possession of said document to fact-check these renditions. For example, without proper sourcing, the claim that Eldrene was Red Ajah appears absurd.

[[User:ASisterOfTheBlue|ASisterOfTheBlue]] ([[User talk:ASisterOfTheBlue|talk]]) 14:58, September 17, 2016 (UTC)



SisteroftheBlue,

Fact checks complete.  No reference to Red Ajah in TWoTC.  Eldrene's ajah was always listed as "unknown" in the header and to say otherwise in the body of text was an invented falsehood.  If anything she was probably a Green - being the fighter that she was - but thats only speculation - Jordan never told us.  Also to say she was a red seems to ignore the fact that she actually married and bonded a man.  I believe there is some confusion related to her tragic relationship with Tetsuan - who was a red.  Unobservant readers have blended the two characters.

The editor who made these changes is an unknown contributor who obviously can't find the time to join our community and would rather make changes under the veil of anonymity.  They tried again in late 2017 and I reversed the attempt a second time.
